newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grains drift lower on quiet markets.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grains drift lower on quiet markets.

text.p: UK cash grain brokers reported little activity as players await the outcome of the weekly European Union (EU) grain tender.
"At again a case of being in the right place at the right to get what business there is going on," said one broker.
On the fob market two trades were reported late on Wednesday when Jan/Mar feed wheat fetched 105.00 and 104.50 stg a tonne ex-east coast ports.
Markets were around 0.50 stg apart with May offered at 99.50 stg and bid 99 stg.
June was bid 99.75 stg with an offer of 100.50 stg while Oct/Dec had sellers at 101.50 and buyers at 101 stg.
Jan/Mar was bid 103.50 and offered at 104 stg a tonne.
Delivered trade was light with traded level 0.,50 to one stg down from Wednesday.
In East Anglia May feed wheat was fetching 101 and 101.50 stg while new crop Oct/Dec traded at 103.50 and 103.00 stg.
Old crop feed wheat in then Avon range was trading at 100 and 99.50 stg for May while spot new crop was fetching 99 stg a tonne.
Feed barley in the Avon range was trading at 100 stg for April.
